units.source_text: 古歌：“我亲自摘菜，汲水又拾薪。

en.t: An old poem says: "I myself pick greens, draw water, and gather firewood.

units.source_text: 全赖此功德，会得法华经。”

en.t: Through the merit of these acts, I shall come to understand the Lotus Sutra."
It appears in the Shuiishu and is said to have been composed by Gyoki.
